# Aevion Studio — Creative Technology & AI Software Studio

> Aevion Studio is an AI software & digital engineering studio founded by Sai Vinoth. We engineer high-performance web applications, autonomous AI pipelines, SaaS platforms, and GPU-accelerated creative motion systems.

## Official Canonical URLs
- Website: https://aevion.studio
- Studio: https://aevion.studio/studio
- Work & Case Studies: https://aevion.studio/projects
- First-Party Products: https://aevion.studio/products
- Open Source: https://aevion.studio/open-source
- Services & Capabilities: https://aevion.studio/services
- 3D & WebGL Lab: https://aevion.studio/showcase
- Process & Methodology: https://aevion.studio/process
- Contact & Configurator: https://aevion.studio/contact

## Core Disciplines & Services
- Autonomous AI & LLM Systems (Groq Llama 3.3, Streaming SSE, Vector RAG)
- Modern Web Applications (Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript)
- GPU-Accelerated Motion & WebGL (GSAP 3 ScrollTrigger, Three.js, Shaders)
- Full-Stack SaaS Engineering (PostgreSQL, Supabase, Stripe, Edge CDN)
- High-Performance UI/UX & Design Systems (Tailwind CSS v4, Zero-CLS)
